name: Gaze of Malevolence
body:
The baleful power of your watchful eye renders your enemies helpless.

Prerequisite(s): Ominous stare class feature, two bold stare improvements

Benefit(s): When a creature penalized by your ominous state makes a charge attack against you, its penalty to Armor Class is increased by -2, and any bonus it receives to attack and damage rolls is halved. When a creature penalized by your ominous stare attempts to use a spell, spell-like or supernatural ability granted by a good deity or with the good descriptor, it must succeed at a concentration check or lose the action (though not the spell). The DC is equal to 10 + half your class level + your Charisma modifier.
